asked_by: operator 2026-10-15: open at 04:00, 07:00, 08:00/08:30 (news), each top of the hour to 11:00; avoid 09:30; power hour 15:00-16:00
population: Momentum-alert names (ai_reports/sessions/DAY/discord.jsonl.gz), counted for a window only if the name's FIRST alert of the day came before the window starts (no hindsight in who is in play). SIP 1-minute bars 04:00-20:00 from ai_reports/momentum_alerts/DAY.pkl (built by momentum_alert_markouts.py).
entry: Buy at the SIP open of the minute; exit at the SIP close 5 minutes later (primary) and 10 minutes later (information). Cost = full SIP quoted spread at the entry minute (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp). No usable spread = event dropped and counted.
w0400_note: No name has alerted before 04:00, so 04:00 cannot be tested this way; the tick replay (momentum_alert_ticks.py) reports alerts fired 04:00-04:59 as its own bucket instead.
control: Clock windows: one random minute of the same name-day within 30 minutes either side of the window start, outside the window, same hold and cost (a clock rule is not triggered by a run-up, so a two-sided control is fair). Seeded per (day, sym, window).
per_window_test: lift = window net minus control net, averaged within each day first, then across days (day-clustered t).

pass.lift: day-clustered t >= 2.5 in the predicted direction (better; worse for w0930_avoid), using family-wise bar for 10 windows
pass.halves: same sign in both halves (days split at the median day)
pass.power: n >= 60 events and >= 8 days, else UNDERPOWERED
pass.worth_trading: a PASSed window is a trading candidate only if its own NET 5-min mean is > 0; a positive lift on a negative net is 'least bad', not a trade

information_only: events per day per window (opportunity count)
if_pass: pre-register a forward test of entering at that window on the live/sim desk; nothing ships from this sample alone
if_fail: time-of-day entry rules stay out of the live config
